Trophy on the exam result card

notes: The CodeMirror editor and the query results table are not animated, so typing and query output stay immediate.
The page-level MotionSwitch key ignores question changes, so the schema panel keeps its open table while practicing.
MotionSwitch makes the outgoing page inert while it exits, so a double click cannot run a page action twice.
Retaking the exam of a level that is already passed shows the trophy without a burst.
